key_insight: MV-PVMapper combines foundation-model segmentation with multi-view UAV photogrammetry to map individual photovoltaic modules accurately without task-specific training.
engineering_relevance: High-fidelity module maps can support rooftop PV asset inventories and provide a spatial foundation for module-level inspection.
method: Generate module candidates from original UAV images using text-prompted SAM 3.
Project contours into object space with per-module slope correction and verify against representative module dimensions.
Feed accepted instances back to all covering views as box prompts for iterative segmentation, verification and fusion.
evidence_signal: Across three operational rooftop plants surveyed from five directions at approximately 1 cm nadir ground sampling distance, two feedback iterations recovered 7,710 of 7,711 reference modules with no false positives at IoU ≥ 0.5 and achieved a site-averaged aggregated Jaccard index of 97.55%.
watch_item: Performance beyond the three evaluated rooftop plants remains unestablished, and implementation depends on accurate photogrammetry and representative module dimensions.
paper_title: High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
